I'd do it again in a heartbeat.
Jan 2025 • Couples
We walked in and got into the class without prior reservation. We joined 4 other people. We walked to the market and Bella gave us a detailed description of the meat and herbs and noodle she purchased. We made pho, green papaya salad, fried spring rolls. bun cha and egg coffee. She made a complex meal very easy for us to prepare. After we finished cooking we all joined at the table and ate together. It was wonderful with more food than we could eat. We finished with watermelon and oh yeah we had a small shot of local rice whiskey.

BEST COOKING CLASS and AMAZING INSTRUCTOR!
Dec 2019
This is the BEST purchase ever from Klook! And also, what I found out that booking through Klook is cheaper than signing up the class on the spot! I highly recommend this activity, as you don't just learn about cooking but a very in-depth history and culture of Vietnamese cuisine. A big shout out to our local instructor, Cinnamon. She is so friendly and knowledgable, and fret not, she speaks really good English! I would definitely recommend taking the 9 AM morning class for Cinnamon. We were brought to the local market to get fresh ingredients and also learning about the various street food.

Fantastic cooking class in Hanoi Old Quarter! Great for vegans/vegetarians
Oct 2019 • Couples
We did a private cooking class with Cinnamon and it was fantastic! We are both vegan and we loved how accommodating Apron Up were and enjoyed every dish that we created. Cinnamon was an incredible instructor and was so helpful, kind and funny and really made the experience for us! This is a great hands on cooking class but Cinnamon was always there to help us out. The market tour was fantastic and we loved being able to buy the ingredients for the class and see a true Hanoi market experience. Bring an appetite, there’s lots of food! Thanks for being an amazing instructor Cinnamon!
